proposal.reason: Main functional change is removing CollNet execution from network plugin/proxy/backend paths while keeping compatibility-facing interfaces (network). Additional substantive changes remove CollNet transport selection/connect/free flows (transport), delete CollNet logical topology graph preset/search/connect behavior (graph-search), remove CollNet-specific NIC/topology capability parsing and discovery precedence in topology ingestion (device-topology), disable CollNet in built-in algorithm/protocol selection and tuner fallback logic while preserving reserved IDs (tuning), and remove CollNet device-kernel implementations while keeping reserved table slots/null entries (kernels).
